criterion: restricted ansatz (the other r-1 (u,v) pairs are held fixed and only the w vectors are recombined): reduction by one term is possible exactly when vec(u_k v_k^T) lies in the span of the remaining vec(u_r v_r^T). Independence therefore certifies irreducibility for THIS ansatz only; a reduction that also changes the (u,v) pairs is not covered by this test.
